_doc: P3069: what each workflow does and whose ideas it uses, in our own words. Edit here, then run: node scripts/ci/workflow-about.js --write

ci: the Athom homey CLI docs for the validate levels
publish: Athom's official Homey app GitHub Actions (athombv)
the Homey developer docs on build channels
enrich: Koen Kanters and the zigbee-herdsman-converters / Zigbee2MQTT contributors
the zigpy / ZHA device handler authors
JohanBendz's original Tuya Zigbee app (read-only reference)
forum: the Homey Community forum members who share fingerprints and diagnostics (read-only, never quoted)
Discourse for its public JSON/RSS endpoints
autopilot: Renovate and Dependabot for the merge-when-green pattern
diag: Homey users who send diagnostic reports by mail
the Homey developer docs on app diagnostics
kb: Koen Kanters and the zigbee-herdsman-converters contributors
zigpy / ZHA, deCONZ, tuya-local, tinytuya and localtuya authors

activity-monitor.yml.what: Collects one day of repo, forum and crash activity into a private report. The schedule is off; the orchestrator covers it.

agent-reach.yml.what: Cross-checks the forum watchers through a second free channel (RSS / web readers) and reports channel health.
also_thanks: Panniantong/agent-reach for the multi-channel reader idea

ai-monthly-audit.yml.what: Monthly code audit; uses an AI only when a free quota is configured and falls back to local checks otherwise.

auto-bot-issue-triage.yml.what: Sorts issues opened by our own bots: pulls fingerprints out, records state, closes them. Human issues are never closed here.

auto-close-supported.yml.what: Checks open issues against what the app already supports and prepares answers; closing human issues stays manual.

auto-enrich-closed-loop.yml.what: Every few hours: gathers new fingerprints from mail, diagnostics and public device databases and adds them to our own drivers.

auto-fix-and-publish.yml.what: Runs the safe automatic fixes, the gates, then sends a build to the Athom draft/test channel.

auto-publish-on-push.yml.what: Publishes to the Athom draft channel after a code push that passes the gates (docs-only pushes are skipped).

auto-reopen-on-comment.yml.what: Reopens a closed issue when a real person comments on it, so the daily jobs look at it again.

autonomous-verification.yml.what: Every six hours: checks red/green of every workflow and writes to our own digest issue only when the state changes.

bastien-promote-upstream.yml.what: Moves what we learned on the bastien-home branch towards master and stable, one way only, never the app ID or version.

bastien-publish.yml.what: Publishes the private Bastien house app (its own app ID only); manual by default.

blakadder-fetch.yml.what: Reads the Blakadder Zigbee database and cross-references it with our device list.

bug-report-auto-pr.yml.what: Turns a bug report into a draft fix PR; the AI step is optional and the job works without it.

build-error-diag.yml.what: Opens the Athom build page in a headless browser to read why a build failed (manual or daily).

ci-self-check.yml.what: Checks the CI files themselves: actionlint, YAML, hygiene, report shape and lint ratchets; fails only on new debt.

code-quality.yml.what: Lint and code checks on pushes and PRs, plus the guard that we never write to the upstream repo.

collect-diagnostics.yml.what: Weekly collection of diagnostics into a report artifact.

community-inbox.yml.what: Daily single view of open issues, PRs and unanswered forum posts, written as links with short summaries. Read-only.

continuous-flow.yml.what: One manual pipeline that replaces about ten older daily jobs (maintenance, enrich, reports).

delete-johan-comments.yml.what: Manual clean-up of our own old comments on the upstream repo; dry run by default.

delete-own-upstream-comments.yml.what: Manual clean-up of our own upstream comments, behind an explicit confirmation input.

dependabot-auto-merge.yml.what: Merges Dependabot updates once checks are green.

deploy-pages.yml.what: Builds and deploys the Device Finder site to GitHub Pages.

doc-coverage.yml.what: Lists modules, gates and workflows that no doc describes yet. Report only, never fails.

draft-to-test-fleet.yml.what: Promotes the latest draft to test for each of our three apps in one manual run.

draft-to-test.yml.what: Promotes one app's draft build to the test channel (manual).

driver-maintenance.yml.what: Weekly: scaffolds missing drivers, finds fingerprint conflicts and proposes a PR.

e2e-dashboard-test.yml.what: End-to-end check of the diagnostics dashboard, triggered after the daily flow.

fetch-diags.yml.what: Fetches diagnostic mails every six hours and stores the structured part.

fleet-intelligent-enrich.yml.what: Twice a day: enrichment across all driver classes within the free scraping budget.

forum-pm-read.yml.what: Reads our forum private messages for fingerprints and diagnostic IDs. Never posts; artifact only.

forum-poll.yml.what: Every four hours: scans the forum thread, PMs and screenshots for device data. Never posts.

free-scrape-crossref.yml.what: Nightly cross-reference through free, keyless readers (Jina, Microlink, Wayback). Never posts.
also_thanks: Jina Reader, Microlink, AllOrigins and the Internet Archive for free read access

gmail-diagnostics.yml.what: Analyses diagnostic mails four times a day; works with local rules, AI only within free quota.

gmail-token-keepalive.yml.what: Daily check that the mail login still works; raises a redacted alert in our own repo if not.

homey-app-cicd.yml.manual.what: Older full CI/CD pipeline kept as a disabled reference file.

homey-app-validate.yml.what: Runs homey app validate at every level on code changes.

housekeeping.yml.what: Weekly tidy of the repo root: only unreferenced files matching explicit rules.

kb-refresh.yml.what: Weekly incremental refresh of the knowledge base from public device projects, delivered as one draft PR.

knowledge-graph-sync.yml.what: Rebuilds the device knowledge graph; schedule off because the nightly audit does it.

l99-inbox-intelligence.yml.what: Three times a day: mail, issues and forum (shadow) into one prioritised private report. Never posts, never invents a product ID.

labeler.yml.what: Labels PRs by touched paths; never checks out PR code.

market-couples-intake.yml.what: Collects manufacturer/product pairs from every public source and our own diagnostics, with device-truth locks.

mega-crawl.yml.what: Runs every crawler in a row; schedule off since it produced nothing that was kept.

monthly-community-sync.yml.what: Manual sync of fingerprints from community projects; only adds data.

monthly-device-enrichment.yml.what: Manual device enrichment pass, now part of the daily pipeline.

monthly-enrichment.yml.what: Manual monthly pass over forum threads, PRs and drivers; only adds.

monthly-scan.yml.what: Monthly scan of Zigbee2MQTT for Tuya devices we do not cover yet.

monthly-tuya-intelligence.yml.what: Monthly link audit of our references; schedule off until its commit step is fixed.

nightly-audit.yml.what: Nightly full audit, data validator and knowledge-graph rebuild.

node22-tests.yml.what: Runs the test suite on Node 22, the runtime Homey apps use since firmware 12.9.

notifications.yml.what: Internal notifications on issue and PR events (no secrets in the output).

offline-crash-analyzer.yml.what: Offline heuristic crash analysis; schedule off since the orchestrator runs it.

open-code-review.yml.what: Twice a week: deterministic file selection and Homey rules for review; skipped when nothing relevant changed.
also_thanks: Alibaba's Open Code Review project for the review flow idea

platform-budget.yml.what: Reports payload size, memory and Actions/API usage against the platform limits. Read-only.

pr-gate.yml.what: Blocks PRs with bad versions, duplicate manufacturer/product pairs or broken manifests.

project-resilience.yml.what: Daily inventory of features and past bugs, sorted by the biggest Homey gaps first.

publish-diagnose.yml.what: Runs after each stable publish and explains what went wrong when it failed.

publish-self-heal.yml.what: Every four hours: detects Athom processing failures and retries safely.

publish-stable.yml.what: Publishes the stable app to the test channel when stable-v5 moves.

publish.yml.what: Manual publish through Athom's official actions (no CLI login).

recurrent-orchestrator.yml.what: Daily pipeline that runs all analysers in order and writes one report.

safe-sync-stable.yml.what: Daily careful sync of reliability fixes from master to stable-v5.

self-improve.yml.what: Weekly self-review of scripts and data; no external calls.

shadow-policy-check.yml.what: Checks that our scripts keep forum and upstream actions in shadow (read-only) mode.

smart-pr-merge.yml.what: Merges PRs that pass every check; the AI review is optional and skipped without a free quota.

smart-update.yml.what: Plans dependency and data updates; schedule off, manual only.

stale.yml.what: Weekly marking of stale issues and PRs.

syntax-check.yml.what: Syntax and SDK3 checks on every code push.

temporal-monitor.yml.what: Matches new issues against known bug patterns; schedule off since the orchestrator runs it.

tuya-deep-diag.yml.what: Manual deep recovery of one diagnostic report from every source we have.

unified-ci.yml.what: Main CI pipeline on pushes and PRs (docs-only pushes skipped).

upstream-guard.yml.what: Reusable check that a workflow never writes to the upstream repository.

validate.yml.what: Daily and per-PR homey app validation.

verified-publish-and-diagnostics.yml.what: Manual verify, diagnose and publish-to-test for a chosen version.

version-health.yml.what: Twice a week: reads build states from the Athom Apps API and flags versions with crashes or failed processing.

weekly-sovereign-loop.yml.what: Weekly heavy pass on free GitHub minutes; later automation only reads its report.
